tvShow.name: GROW UP SHOW -Sunflower Circus-
tvShow.originalName: グロウアップショウ ～ひまわりのサーカス団～
tvShow.overview: Step right up to 1950s Japan! The postwar economy is booming, but the Sunflower Circus is not. Led by ringmaster Maria, the cash-strapped troupe tours the country in desperate competition for a spot in the Circus Collection–an elite global festival. When circus prodigy Mizuka Tsurumaki joins their ranks, the Sunflower Circus’s fortune shifts, finally giving them a shot at big top glory.

episodes.name: Welcome to the Sunflower Circus!
episodes.overview: In 1950s Japan, penniless Mizuka meets two circus girls, sparking a dream-filled new beginning.

episodes.name: That Was So Dazzling
episodes.overview: The "Sunflower Circus" is headed to Toyokawa, a popular and officially sanctioned performance venue.

episodes.name: I Don't Want to Show My Scars
episodes.overview: Determined to surpass "Shiny Lavender", the "Sunflower Circus" prepares for its upcoming show.

episodes.name: I Just Can't Bring Myself to Be Honest
episodes.overview: The "Sunflower Circus" had a successful show in Toyokawa, but their earnings were seized by debt collectors.

episodes.name: There Is Nowhere I Belong
episodes.overview: Akane storms off as Mizuka searches the mountains for Rafflesia Circus’s missing François.

episodes.name: A Sinister Legend Summons a Storm
episodes.overview: Nanami Sumeragi’s team makes headlines with newspapers asking if they could surpass the "Lotus Circus."

episodes.name: I Don't Get the Circus
episodes.overview: Mizuka, determined to challenge Mitscher, returns to the group members who all look very serious.
